detail.title: Investigating Copying Fidelity and Heredity Thresholds in Prebiotic Systems
detail.summary: This research advances the understanding of heredity thresholds by synthesizing theoretical models of RNA polymer evolution and error thresholds in replicators. We have revised the notebook to incorporate mathematical findings regarding compositional heredity and mutation-driven error limits.
